title: Comprehensive Table of Contents
requirement_text: Complete table of contents for Module 1 and overall dossier organization including regional regulatory submission forms.

title: Forms and Administrative Information
requirement_text: Official regional administrative application forms, cover letters, application tracking information, and regional compliance declarations.

title: Prescribing Information and Product Labeling
requirement_text: Draft package insert, Summary of Product Characteristics (SmPC), inner and outer container mock-ups, and patient information leaflets.

title: Information about the Experts
requirement_text: Curriculum vitae, qualification statements, and signed expert declarations for Quality, Nonclinical, and Clinical overview authors.

title: Risk Management Plan (RMP) / REMS
requirement_text: Pharmacovigilance plan, risk evaluation and mitigation strategies (REMS), EU-RMP, and post-authorization safety study protocols.
source: ICH M4 Regional / GVP Module V

title: CTD Table of Contents
requirement_text: Comprehensive Table of Contents for Modules 2, 3, 4, and 5 of the Common Technical Document.

title: CTD Introduction
requirement_text: General introduction to the pharmaceutical substance, its pharmacological class, mode of action, and proposed clinical indication.

title: Quality Overall Summary (QOS)
requirement_text: High-level summary of the chemical, pharmaceutical, and biological data presented in Module 3, discussing critical quality attributes and control strategies.

title: Nonclinical Overview
requirement_text: Integrated assessment of the nonclinical pharmacology, pharmacokinetics, and toxicology findings, evaluating human safety margins and risk-benefit profile.

title: Clinical Overview
requirement_text: Critical analysis of the clinical efficacy, clinical safety, biopharmaceutics, and clinical pharmacology data, presenting the overall benefit-risk balance.

title: Nonclinical Written and Tabulated Summaries
requirement_text: Detailed written and tabulated summaries of nonclinical studies across Pharmacology (2.6.1-2.6.3), Pharmacokinetics (2.6.4-2.6.5), and Toxicology (2.6.6-2.6.7).

title: Clinical Summary
requirement_text: Detailed summary of clinical findings including biopharmaceutics (2.7.1), clinical pharmacology (2.7.2), clinical efficacy (2.7.3), clinical safety (2.7.4), literature (2.7.5), and individual studies (2.7.6).

title: Module 3 Table of Contents
requirement_text: Complete Table of Contents for Module 3 (Quality / CMC body of data).

title: Drug Substance - General Information
requirement_text: Nomenclature, chemical structure, molecular formula, molecular weight, and general physicochemical properties of the active pharmaceutical ingredient (API).

title: Drug Substance - Manufacture
requirement_text: Manufacturer names and sites, synthetic process description, flow diagrams, in-process controls, raw material controls, process validation, and manufacturing development.

title: Drug Substance - Characterisation
requirement_text: Elucidation of chemical structure and other characteristics, impurity profiles (organic, inorganic, residual solvents, elemental impurities, mutagenic impurities).

title: Drug Substance - Control of Drug Substance
requirement_text: Specifications, analytical validation procedures, justification of specifications, and batch analysis results for the drug substance.

title: Drug Substance - Reference Standards or Materials
requirement_text: Source, characterization, and qualification of primary and working reference standards used for drug substance testing.

title: Drug Substance - Container Closure System
requirement_text: Description of the container closure system for storage and shipment of the drug substance, including materials of construction and suitability.

title: Drug Substance - Stability
requirement_text: Stability testing protocol, long-term, accelerated, and stress testing data, retest period justification, and post-approval stability commitments.

title: Drug Product - Description and Composition
requirement_text: Description of the dosage form, quantitative formula, composition of the drug product, and accompanying reconstitution diluents.

title: Drug Product - Pharmaceutical Development
requirement_text: Formulation development, Quality by Design (QbD) studies, physicochemical compatibility, overages, manufacturing process development, and microbiological attributes.

title: Drug Product - Manufacture
requirement_text: Manufacturer information, batch formula, manufacturing process flow diagram, in-process controls, and process validation / verification protocols.

title: Drug Product - Control of Excipients
requirement_text: Specifications, analytical methods, validation, justification of specifications, and safety assessments for novel excipients or human/animal origin excipients.

title: Drug Product - Control of Drug Product
requirement_text: Finished product release specifications, analytical procedures, method validation reports, batch analyses, and impurity characterization.

title: Drug Product - Reference Standards or Materials
requirement_text: Source, characterization, and qualification of reference standards utilized in finished product testing and assay assays.

title: Drug Product - Container Closure System
requirement_text: Description of primary and secondary packaging, materials of construction, integrity testing, moisture/light protection, and extractables/leachables studies.

title: Drug Product - Stability
requirement_text: Formal stability protocol, real-time long-term and accelerated stability results, shelf-life specification, in-use stability, and post-approval commitment.

title: Appendices - Facilities and Adventitious Agents
requirement_text: Information on manufacturing facilities, equipment qualification, adventitious agent safety evaluation (viral, TSE/BSE risk), and novel excipients.

title: Module 3 Literature References
requirement_text: Key bibliographic literature references supporting Module 3 Quality documentation.

title: Module 4 Table of Contents
requirement_text: Complete Table of Contents for Module 4 (Nonclinical Study Reports).

title: Pharmacology Study Reports
requirement_text: Complete study reports for primary pharmacodynamics, secondary pharmacodynamics, safety pharmacology (hERG, CNS, respiratory, cardiovascular), and pharmacodynamic drug interactions.

title: Pharmacokinetics Study Reports
requirement_text: Nonclinical PK study reports covering bioanalytical methods, absorption, tissue distribution, in vitro and in vivo metabolism, excretion, and PK drug interactions.

title: Toxicology Study Reports
requirement_text: GLP nonclinical toxicology reports including single-dose, repeat-dose, genotoxicity (Ames, in vitro chromosomal, in vivo micronucleus), carcinogenicity, reproductive/developmental toxicity (seg I, II, III), and local tolerance.

title: Module 4 Literature References
requirement_text: Bibliographic references cited in nonclinical overviews and study reports.

title: Module 5 Table of Contents
requirement_text: Complete Table of Contents for Module 5 (Clinical Study Reports).

title: Tabular Listing of All Clinical Studies
requirement_text: Structured tabular listing of all clinical studies initiated, completed, or ongoing (Phase 1, Phase 2, Phase 3, BA/BE, PK/PD, safety trials).

title: Reports of Biopharmaceutic Studies
requirement_text: Reports of bioavailability (BA), bioequivalence (BE), in vitro-in vivo correlation (IVIVC), and bioanalytical method validation reports for human biological samples.

title: Reports of Studies Pertinent to PK using Human Biomaterials
requirement_text: Plasma protein binding studies, hepatic metabolism, CYP enzyme inhibition and induction assays using human hepatocytes or microsomes.

title: Reports of Human Pharmacokinetic (PK) Studies
requirement_text: Healthy volunteer single/multiple ascending dose PK reports, patient PK studies, intrinsic factor PK (renal/hepatic impairment), extrinsic factor PK (drug-drug interactions, food effect), and population PK models.

title: Reports of Human Pharmacodynamic (PD) Studies
requirement_text: Healthy subject and patient pharmacodynamic and PK/PD exposure-response modeling and clinical biomarker study reports.

title: Reports of Efficacy and Safety Studies
requirement_text: Pivotal Phase 2 and Phase 3 randomized controlled trial reports (ICH E3 CSRs) pertinent to the claimed indication, uncontrolled studies, integrated analyses (ISE, ISS), and other clinical safety reports.

title: Reports of Postmarketing Experience
requirement_text: Postmarketing periodic safety update reports (PSUR / PBRER), clinical experience in other countries, and registry studies.

title: Case Report Forms and Individual Patient Listings
requirement_text: CRFs for deaths, other serious adverse events (SAEs), and adverse events leading to discontinuation, along with individual patient listings.

title: Module 5 Literature References
requirement_text: Bibliographic references cited in the clinical overview, clinical summaries, and clinical study reports.
